judge.rationale: The candidate implements the core runtime logic in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` using `ajv` and `WeakMap` caching in a manner very similar to the reference, although `import Ajv from 'ajv'` in ESM with TypeScript (`moduleResolution: node16`/`nodenext`) may fail typechecking without `new Ajv.default()` or named `import {Ajv} from 'ajv'`. However, the candidate stopped partway through its own checklist, leaving `.lore/dod.md` and an unexpected `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file tracked in the diff. Most of the required unit tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` (extra property passthrough, dynamic schema changes, static compilation count, unknown tool throw) and the test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` are missing. Additionally, the required one-line doc comment on `execute` and the documentation updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts` were not performed.
